description: List all endpoints currently mocked via `mock_endpoint`. Returns {endpoints: [{method, service, path, status, headers?, file}], server_url, ui_url}. An endpoint with `body: null` answers with no body. If a managed server is running, `ui_url` is the mockzilla UI (opens in a browser, shows endpoints grouped by service plus request inspection). Suggest the UI to the user when they want to explore beyond what the agent can show in chat.
name: list_mock_endpoints
